name: soundings
description: Discover relevant possibilities, form grounded judgments, and carry inquiry into the work with four independent skills.

interface.shortDescription: Research, understand, explore, and shape the work
interface.longDescription: Soundings helps agents proactively inspect external possibilities before substantial open choices, reconcile material into local judgments, develop concrete creative possibilities, and carry consequential choices or corrections through the original task. It can begin with an existing project and discover the question most worth pursuing. Four independent skills can own complete commissions or contribute inside an existing task; installed methods do not guarantee host selection or better outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Before settling this open choice, investigate relevant solutions and references and carry a grounded judgment into the work.
Reconcile these materials, or find the unresolved project question most worth pursuing, and carry it to a useful result.
Develop a concrete creative possibility, or make a consequential correction judgeable and carry it through.
